[attribute-document-id]
=== `@document-id` Related Object Document Identifier

Identifier of a document within a publication that is (or contains) the target of the <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>> element.

#### Usage/Remarks
This attribute holds an external identifier assigned to a publication that is part of the description of a related object (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>).

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| Text, numbers, or special characters| An identifier for the document that contains the related object
                        (<<element-related-object,`<related-object>`>>).
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
